spacing.none.description: Component · 0. Use for: explicitly removing padding or gap — flush lists, joined button groups, edge-to-edge media. Not for: hiding content.

spacing.xxs.description: Component · 2px optical nudge. Use for: badge offset on an avatar or icon, status dot position, gap between stacked lines in dense data. Not for: padding of anything interactive or gaps between interactive elements.

spacing.xs.description: Component · Tight gap inside a component. Use for: icon-to-text in badges, chips and inline links; title-to-description in list items and card headers; badge padding; field-to-supporting-text gap. Not for: control padding (use control/*) or gaps between separate interactive elements (use md or more).

spacing.sm.description: Component · Compact gap. Use for: label-to-field gap, compact chip and tag padding, icon-to-text in small non-control elements. Not for: layout or control padding.

spacing.md.description: Component · Default small gap. Use for: tooltip and popover padding, gap between related interactive elements (button group, chip row, toolbar icon buttons), dense list-row vertical padding, menu item gap. Not for: card, dialog or panel padding (use layout/container).

spacing.lg.description: Component · Comfortable gap. Use for: list-row padding, menu padding-inline, avatar-to-text gap in list items, gap between the parts of a component (toast header and body). Not for: space between components on a page (use layout/*).

spacing.xl.description: Component · Large gap inside a component. Use for: list-row and menu-row padding-inline on touch, content-to-action gap in banners and snackbars, table cell padding-inline. Not for: container edges of cards, dialogs and panels (use layout/container).

spacing.2xl.description: Component · Extra-large gap inside a large component, when xl is too tight and 3xl too loose — side sheet header padding, empty-state content gap. Rare. Not for: layout.

spacing.3xl.description: Component · Largest step inside a component that owns its own spacing — navigation drawer header, illustration-to-text in empty states. Not for: card or dialog padding, which changes per platform (use layout/container).

spacing.control.padding-inline.sm.description: Control · Horizontal padding of sm (32px) controls. Dense web only: tables, toolbars, filters. Never mix with another size.

spacing.control.padding-inline.md.description: Control · Horizontal padding of md (40px) controls. Default on web.

spacing.control.padding-inline.lg.description: Control · Horizontal padding of lg (48px) controls. Default on tablet and mobile.

spacing.control.padding-inline.xl.description: Control · Horizontal padding of xl (56px) controls. Tablet and mobile primary actions only.

spacing.control.gap.sm.description: Control · Icon-to-label gap in sm (32px) controls.

spacing.control.gap.md.description: Control · Icon-to-label gap in md (40px) controls. Default on web.

spacing.control.gap.lg.description: Control · Icon-to-label gap in lg (48px) controls. Default on tablet and mobile.

spacing.control.gap.xl.description: Control · Icon-to-label gap in xl (56px) controls.

radius.none.description: Square corners. Anything attached to a screen edge — app bar, sidebar, navigation rail, full-bleed media, table cells.

radius.xxs.description: Hairline rounding for tiny marks: progress and slider tracks, inline code.

radius.xs.description: Inner corners of joined segments (button group, split button), checkbox, small badge, tags inside dense text.

radius.sm.description: Tooltip, chips and tags, rounded-square avatar sm.

radius.md.description: Default control radius: Button, Icon button, Text field, Select, Segmented button at sm, md and lg; small popovers; rounded-square avatar md.

radius.lg.description: Menus, dropdown lists and popovers anchored to a control (split button menu); rounded-square avatar lg.

radius.xl.description: xl (56) controls on tablet and mobile, list items shown as cards, rounded-square avatar xl.

radius.2xl.description: Cards, dashboard widgets, tiles, banners inside content.

radius.4xl.description: Bottom and side sheets (only the corners facing the content), hero containers.

radius.full.description: Pills and circles: circular avatar, switch track and thumb, count and dot badges, pill chips. Never on rectangles that can grow tall.

border.focus.offset.description: Gap between control and focus ring.

size.container.xs.description: Max-width 384. Small dialogs (confirm, single question), toasts.

size.container.sm.description: Max-width 480. Default dialog, simple forms in a dialog.

size.container.md.description: Max-width 560. Large dialog, side sheet, multi-field forms in a dialog.

size.container.lg.description: Max-width 640. Single-column page forms, settings panels.

size.container.xl.description: Max-width 768. Reading column for long text (about 70 characters per line), detail pages.

size.container.2xl.description: Max-width 1024. Medium content area — wizards, detail pages with a side column.

size.container.3xl.description: Max-width 1280. Default maximum width of main page content on wide screens.

size.container.4xl.description: Max-width 1440. Wide data screens — dashboards, large tables. Never wider.

size.icon.xs.description: Icon 12. Indicators and decoration only (status glyph inside a badge or chip). Never the only carrier of meaning.

size.icon.sm.description: Icon 16. Dense web: inside sm controls, table cells, inline with caption or small text.

size.icon.md.description: Icon 20 (optical size). Default on web: inside md controls, menus, list rows, inline with body text.

size.icon.lg.description: Icon 24 (optical size). Default on tablet and mobile: inside lg and xl controls, app bars, navigation.

size.icon.xl.description: Icon 32. Emphasis: leading icon of a banner, avatar fallback at xl.

size.icon.2xl.description: Icon 40 (optical size). Feature or section icons, small empty states.

size.icon.3xl.description: Icon 48 (optical size). Empty states, onboarding, large illustrative icons.

size.control.height.sm.description: Control height 32. Dense web only: tables, toolbars, filters. On touch never without a target-min hit area.

size.control.height.lg.description: Control height 48. Default on tablet and mobile (= touch target).

size.control.height.xl.description: Control height 56. Prominent tablet/mobile primary action (full-width buttons). Not on web.

motion.duration.xs.description: Ripple start, color change on small controls.

motion.duration.md.description: Tooltip, menu open, expand small content.

motion.duration.progress.description: One turn of a looping progress indicator (spinner). NOT reduced to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion — progress indicators are the allowed exception (motion.md).

motion.easing.standard.description: Default for elements that stay on screen.
